title: NonaVong Body | 45mm Light Wood
description:
This NonaVong midsection is 45mm long and can be used in many of DynaVap’s vaporizers. The 45mm NonaVong midsection comes standard on the NonaVong-S and the OmniVong.
The NonaVong midsection has a built in 14mm male connection, this enable use with the appropriate ground glass joint usually found on a glass rig.
Included
1 x 45mm NonaVong Midsection Light Wood
